data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement stems from a tool error rather than a security dispute. The Qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 error when auditing .SRCINFO, causing it to return an overall 'inconclusive' verdict. The DeepSeek model successfully audited all files and correctly determined the package is safe.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: The audit tool should handle partial API failures gracefully. A transient error on a metadata file like .SRCINFO should not force the entire package verdict to 'inconclusive' if the critical execution files (PKGBUILD, install hooks) are successfully audited and found safe.
